reason: The README describes a project AI documentation protocol that maintains structured project knowledge, directs agents to read relevant context before work, and requires documentation updates after tasks, making memory and context management its primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 为 AI 代理提供项目文档知识库协议，帮助会话读取相关上下文并在任务完成后回写项目认知。
summaries.en: Provides a project documentation knowledge-base protocol that helps AI agents read relevant context and write back project knowledge after tasks.

capabilities: Reads project documentation for agent context
